note: Risk thresholds and weights derived from publicly available CEA, MNRE, and industry reports. Scores are indicative only and not a substitute for professional risk assessment.

methodology.overview: Risk scores are computed from actual data inputs where available. Each category is scored 0–100 based on normalized indicators. The overall score is a weighted average. Categories with insufficient data are excluded from scoring and flagged as data-unavailable.
methodology.operational: Based on PLF/CUF values relative to historical benchmarks and technology-specific norms. Lower PLF = higher operational risk for thermal. For renewables, CUF volatility and forced outage data would improve this score (currently unavailable).
methodology.supply: Based on capacity concentration (HHI-style index), demand-supply balance where data available, and dependency on single technology.
methodology.project: Based on under-construction capacity relative to operating base, project concentration, and commissioning pipeline.
methodology.geographic: Based on state concentration (HHI) of installed capacity and generation.
methodology.market: Limited data available. Would require power price data and DISCOM payment data. Currently flagged as data-limited.
methodology.climate: Based on geographic exposure of plants to known climate hazard zones. Currently using state-level proxy data. Detailed site-level climate data not available.
methodology.normalization: All sub-indicators are normalized to 0–100 scale before weighting. A score of 0 = no risk, 100 = maximum risk within the observable range.
dataGaps: Forced outage rates not available in public CEA data
Power price / tariff data not comprehensively available across all states
Site-level climate hazard assessments not available
Monthly PLF trend data limited to FY2024-25 annual averages

nuclear.dataAvailability: Moderate — NPCIL publishes annual generation and capacity data. Plant-level outage data limited.

solar.dataAvailability: Moderate — generation and capacity from CEA/MNRE. Physical risk data requires external datasets.

coal.dataAvailability: Good — CEA PLF data available. Outage data partially available from industry reports.

wind.dataAvailability: Moderate — generation and capacity available. Component failure rates require insurer/OEM data.
